name: reset_ctrl_regs
desc: Reset controller: software reset, hold time, status, reset event count.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.desc: write 1: software reset of the reset outputs (self clearing)

registers.name: HOLD
registers.desc: clocks the reset outputs stay asserted after a request

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: status; write 1 to [1] to clear EVENT
